title: Minecraft Was Built in About a Week as a Side Project
hook: The best-selling game ever started as a one-person side project called Cave Game in May 2009, and it took about a week to get playable. What was the first thing you ever built in Minecraft?

script: Did you know the best selling video game of all time was built by one person in about a week? In May of two thousand nine, a Swedish programmer named Markus Persson was working a day job and making games on the side. He had just seen a blocky mining game called Infiniminer. Within about a week he had a playable prototype he simply called Cave Game. On May seventeenth he posted it to an indie game forum, and Mojang still celebrates that date as Minecraft's birthday. He started selling the unfinished game the very next month. By two thousand ten the game was making enough money that he went full time and co founded Mojang. The finished version one point zero launched in November of two thousand eleven at the first MineCon in Las Vegas. Three years later Microsoft bought Mojang for two and a half billion dollars. Mojang says Minecraft has now sold more than three hundred million copies, more than any other game ever made. And this week it arrived on a brand new console. Minecraft launched on the Nintendo Switch Two on October twenty seventh, with upgraded lighting and a Super Mario world built in. Not bad for a week of spare time. Follow for more gaming history.
